# HavokOS M5 edge cases (todo.md HavokOS M5, the object model): what the
# reference's run_tests.pike table doesn't reach. One case per line,
# <name><TAB><body>, the body escaped as \\ \n \t. Expected results in
# m5_extra.expected.txt are the live Pike driver's own (tools/ref_cases.pike
# -extra); nothing here was hand-predicted.
#
# Three kinds of case:
# - ports of run_tests.pike's Pike-level driver tests (call_out_tests,
#   living_tests, reset_tests, heart_beat_tests, eval_limit_tests), which
#   poke the driver from Pike; here the test_* driver hooks both case
#   runners provide (efun_table.star test_efun_codes()) do the poking;
# - this port's own cases for add_action/command dispatch, init() order,
#   present(), inventories, destruct of a container, shadows, message
#   delivery, call_out order, heart beats, replace_program(), bind(), privs;
# - the helper objects they use, written to /test/tmp_m5_*.c by the first
#   case and removed by the last.
#
# --- helpers
m5 setup helpers	write_file("/test/tmp_m5_log.c", "string *log = ({}); void add(string s) { log += ({ s }); } string *take() { string *r = log; log = ({}); return r; }", 1); write_file("/test/tmp_m5_liv.c", "string name = \\"liv\\"; void L(string s) { \\"/test/tmp_m5_log\\"->add(s); } void create() { enable_commands(); } void set_name(string s) { name = s; } string query_name() { return name; } string tpn() { return this_player() ? this_player()->query_name() : \\"0\\"; } void init() { L(name + \\":init by \\" + tpn()); } void catch_tell(string s) { L(name + \\":tell:\\" + s); } void receive_message(string c, string m) { L(name + \\":msg:\\" + c + \\":\\" + m); } int id(string s) { return s == name || s == \\"liv\\"; } int move_or_destruct(object d) { L(name + \\":mod\\"); move_object(d); return 1; } void move_to(mixed d) { move_object(d); } int do_cmd(string c) { return command(c); } void add_act(string v, int f) { enable_commands(); add_action(\\"act\\", v, f); } int rm_act(string f, string v) { enable_commands(); return remove_action(f, v); } mixed *cmds() { return commands(); } int act(string a) { L(name + \\":act:\\" + query_verb() + \\":\\" + (undefinedp(a) ? \\"UNDEF\\" : a)); return a != \\"fail\\"; } object pres(string s) { return present(s); } void say_it(string s) { enable_commands(); say(s); } mixed nf(string c) { enable_commands(); notify_fail(\\"nope\\"); return query_notify_fail(); }", 1); write_file("/test/tmp_m5_thing.c", "string name = \\"thing\\"; void L(string s) { \\"/test/tmp_m5_log\\"->add(s); } void set_name(string s) { name = s; } string query_name() { return name; } int id(string s) { return s == name || s == \\"thing\\"; } void init() { L(name + \\":init by \\" + (this_player() ? this_player()->query_name() : \\"0\\")); } void move_to(mixed d) { move_object(d); }", 1); write_file("/test/tmp_m5_room.c", "string name = \\"room\\"; void L(string s) { \\"/test/tmp_m5_log\\"->add(s); } string query_name() { return name; } void init() { L(name + \\":init by \\" + (this_player() ? this_player()->query_name() : \\"0\\")); add_action(\\"dance\\", \\"dance\\"); } int dance(string a) { L(\\"dance:\\" + query_verb() + \\":\\" + (undefinedp(a) ? \\"UNDEF\\" : a) + \\":\\" + this_player()->query_name()); return 1; } void catch_tell(string s) { L(name + \\":tell:\\" + s); }", 1); write_file("/test/tmp_m5_shadow.c", "string query_name() { return \\"shadowed\\"; } string only_shadow() { return \\"s\\"; } object start(object v) { return shadow(v, 1); } void stop() { remove_shadow(this_object()); }", 1); write_file("/test/tmp_m5_rp_base.c", "int b = 7; int q() { return b; } string who() { return \\"base\\"; }", 1); write_file("/test/tmp_m5_rp.c", "inherit \\"/test/tmp_m5_rp_base\\"; void create() { replace_program(\\"/test/tmp_m5_rp_base\\"); } string who() { return \\"top\\"; }", 1); write_file("/test/tmp_m5_hbliv.c", "int n; object tp; void create() { enable_commands(); set_heart_beat(1); } void heart_beat() { n++; tp = this_player(); } mixed q() { return ({ n, tp == this_object() }); }", 1); write_file("/test/tmp_m5_beat.c", "int beats; void heart_beat() { beats++; } int q() { return beats; } int on(int n) { return set_heart_beat(n); }", 1); return 1;
# --- ports of run_tests.pike call_out_tests()
call_out_info owner of a fn pointer	object other = clone_object("/test/base_b"); mixed *mine() { return filter(call_out_info(), (: $1[0] == this_object() :)); } mixed *of(object o) { return filter(call_out_info(), (: $1[0] == $(o) :)); } @@ call_out("eval", 50); call_out((: eval :), 60); call_out(bind((: eval :), other), 70); mixed *a = mine(), *b = of(other); remove_call_out(); destruct(other); return ({ sizeof(a), a[0][1], a[0][2] > 40, a[1][1], sizeof(b), b[0][1] });
remove_call_out() takes owned pointers	object other = clone_object("/test/base_b"); mixed *mine() { return filter(call_out_info(), (: $1[0] == this_object() :)); } mixed *of(object o) { return filter(call_out_info(), (: $1[0] == $(o) :)); } @@ call_out(bind((: eval :), other), 70); call_out((: eval :), 60); remove_call_out(); int n = sizeof(mine()), m = sizeof(of(other)); destruct(other); return ({ n, m });
destruct drops owned call_outs	object other = clone_object("/test/base_b"); mixed *mine() { return filter(call_out_info(), (: $1[0] == this_object() :)); } mixed *of(object o) { return filter(call_out_info(), (: $1[0] == $(o) :)); } @@ call_out(bind((: eval :), other), 70); int before = sizeof(of(other)); destruct(other); return ({ before, sizeof(filter(call_out_info(), (: !objectp($1[0]) :))) });
find/remove_call_out by name and handle	object other = clone_object("/test/base_b"); mixed *mine() { return filter(call_out_info(), (: $1[0] == this_object() :)); } mixed *of(object o) { return filter(call_out_info(), (: $1[0] == $(o) :)); } @@ int h1 = call_out("eval", 30); int h2 = call_out("eval", 90); int f = find_call_out("eval"); int r = remove_call_out("eval"); int f2 = find_call_out("eval"); int fh = find_call_out(h2); int rh = remove_call_out(h2); destruct(other); return ({ f <= 30 && f > 20, r <= 30 && r > 20, f2 > 80, fh > 80, rh > 80, find_call_out(h2), remove_call_out(h1), sizeof(mine()) });
# --- port of living_tests()
find_living newest, then most recently found	object a = clone_object("/test/living_npc"), b = clone_object("/test/living_npc"); a->name("orc"); b->name("orc"); object f1 = find_living("orc"); b->off(); object f2 = find_living("orc"); b->on(); object f3 = find_living("orc"); a->name("goblin"); object f4 = find_living("orc"), f5 = find_living("goblin"); destruct(b); object f6 = find_living("orc"); int nl = member_array(a, livings()) >= 0; a->off(); int nl2 = member_array(a, livings()); object fp = find_player("goblin"); int named = member_array(a, named_livings()); destruct(a); return ({ f1 == b, f2 == a, f3 == a, f4 == b, f5 == a, f6, nl, nl2, fp, find_living("goblin"), named });
# --- ports of reset_tests()
reset lazy, moving in, set_reset, sweep	object a, b, c; @@ test_reset_cfg(100, 50, 1); a = clone_object("/test/resetter"); b = clone_object("/test/resetter"); int t = time(); int rt = test_reset_time(a); mixed r = ({ rt >= t + 49, rt <= t + 100, a->stats()[0] }); test_set_reset_time(a, 1); a->ping(); a->ping(); r += ({ a->stats()[0], test_reset_time(a) > t }); test_set_reset_time(b, 1); c = clone_object("/test/resetter"); c->move_to(b); r += ({ b->stats()[0] }); set_reset(a, 5); int d = test_reset_time(a) - time(); r += ({ d >= 4 && d <= 5 }); set_reset(a); r += ({ test_reset_time(a) - time() >= 49 }); test_reset_cfg(100, 50, 0); test_set_reset_time(a, 1); test_set_last_used(a, time()); test_sweep(); r += ({ a->stats()[0] }); test_reset_cfg(0, 0, 1); set_reset(b); r += ({ test_reset_time(b) }); foreach (object o in ({ a, b, c })) destruct(o); return r;
clean_up idle objects and its flag	object a, bp, kid, plain, b; @@ test_reset_cfg(100, 50, 1); a = clone_object("/test/resetter"); bp = load_object("/test/resetter"); kid = clone_object("/test/resetter_kid"); b = clone_object("/test/resetter"); test_set_last_used(a, time() - 100); test_set_last_used(bp, time() - 100); test_sweep(); mixed r = ({ a->stats()[1..], bp->stats()[1..] }); test_sweep(); r += ({ a->stats()[1] }); a->set_ret(0); test_set_last_used(a, time() - 100); test_sweep(); test_set_last_used(a, time() - 100); test_sweep(); r += ({ a->stats()[1] }); plain = clone_object("/test/gthing"); test_set_last_used(plain, time() - 100); test_sweep(); r += ({ test_no_clean_up(plain) }); test_set_last_used(b, time() - 10); test_sweep(); r += ({ b->stats()[1] }); test_reset_cfg(0, 0, 1); foreach (object o in ({ a, bp, kid, plain, b })) destruct(o); return r;
# --- ports of heart_beat_tests()
set_heart_beat intervals	int beats; void heart_beat() { beats++; } int beat(int n) { int before = beats; test_hb(n); return beats - before; } @@ mixed r = ({ ({ set_heart_beat(1), query_heart_beat(), beat(3) }), ({ set_heart_beat(3), query_heart_beat(), beat(9) }), ({ set_heart_beat(-1), query_heart_beat() }), ({ set_heart_beat(0), query_heart_beat(), beat(5), set_heart_beat(0) }), ({ set_heart_beat(-5), query_heart_beat(), beat(2) }) }); set_heart_beat(0); return r;
heart beat slots	object *bs = ({}); @@ for (int k = 0; k < 9; k++) { object o = clone_object("/test/tmp_m5_beat"); o->on(1); bs += ({ o }); } int *before = map(bs, (: $1->q() :)); int *sizes = test_hb_round(); int *after = map(bs, (: $1->q() :)); mixed d = ({}); for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) d += ({ after[i] - before[i] }); int n = sizeof(heart_beats()); foreach (object o in bs) destruct(o); return ({ d, sort_array(sizes, 1), n, sizeof(heart_beats()) });
heart beat error turns it off	int n; void heart_beat() { n++; if (n == 2) error("hb fail\\n"); } @@ set_heart_beat(1); test_hb(5); return ({ n, query_heart_beat() });
heart beat this_player is the living	object o = clone_object("/test/tmp_m5_hbliv"); test_hb(2); mixed r = o->q(); destruct(o); return r;
# --- ports of eval_limit_tests()
eval limit stops while(1)	int loop() { int n; while (1) n++; return n; } @@ return catch(test_limited("loop", 200000));
eval limit not swallowed by catch	mixed f() { mixed e = catch { for (;;); }; for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++); return e; } @@ return catch(test_limited("f", 200000));
eval limit stops recursion	int f(int n) { return n < 2 ? n : f(n - 1) + f(n - 2); } int g() { return f(40); } @@ return catch(test_limited("g", 200000));
eval limit do-while	int g() { int n; do { n++; } while (1); return n; } @@ return catch(test_limited("g", 200000));
reset_eval_cost extends budget	int h() { int t = time(); while (time() < t + 1) reset_eval_cost(); return 1; } @@ return test_limited("h", 200000);
eval_cost and max_eval_cost	mixed k() { int c = eval_cost(); return ({ c > 0, c <= max_eval_cost(), max_eval_cost() }); } @@ return test_limited("k", 200000);
eval state reset	return test_eval_state();

# --- cleanup
